mapper.select: select count(1) from articles where slug = #{slug}
select count(1) from article_favorites AF join articles A on A.id = AF.article_id where A.slug = #{slug}
select count(1) from comments C join articles A on A.id = C.article_id where A.slug = #{slug}

select A.slug articleSlug, A.title articleTitle, A.description articleDescription, count(AF.user_id) as favoriteCount, A.created_at articleCreatedAt, U.id userId, U.username userUsername, U.bio userBio, U.image userImage from articles A join article_favorites AF on A.id = AF.article_id left join users U on U.id = A.user_id where A.created_at >= datetime('now', '-' || #{days} || ' days') group by A.id order by favoriteCount desc limit #{limit}
